text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeees!
That was another super exciting race!
choice_data_list: That was a powerful, great run!
That was a powerful, great run!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer!!
Sprint and Mile are the best answer!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I feel like I could seize any number of victories!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"I'll run in lots more races,
and become Horse Girl of the Year, you'll see!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Still, before that~...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Let's throw an unbelievable
good-job party!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then, the next day—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer! Did you enjoy the races and the party yesterday?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Now, which race shall we enter next, I wonder?
Leave any race to me, please!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We got results even in a graded race like the Shinzan Kinen.
Let's maintain this momentum
and take on an even bigger stage!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To be chosen as "Umamusume of the Year,"
first comes selection for the "URA Awards"—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: For Taiki Shuttle, the bare minimum requirement was claiming the title of Best Sprinter/Miler, the pinnacle of the Sprint and Mile divisions.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: So, the next race will determine the Classic mile champion—
choice_data_list: Let's enter the NHK Mile Cup!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Wow!
A GⅠ race, right!? Right!?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yahoo!! A fun race filled with
so many strong Umamusume! I am so excited, yes!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Without further ado, let's party!
choice_data_list: Didn't we have the party yesterday?!
Didn't we have the party yesterday?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Non-non, Trainer.
That's not what I mean.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yesterday was the 'Shinzan Kinen' wrap party!
And today is the 'Goal Setting' party!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: And with that—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Let's buy a very, very big piece of meat
for our roast beef main dish~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our sights were set on the NHK Mile Cup,
which would determine the Classic Class mile champion.
